x-e-e5-01.title: 'Most popular' - ederede ahụ na-akwado ya?
x-e-e5-01.topic: Echiche bụ isi na nkọwa na-akwado
x-e-e5-01.goal: Chee ma ozi ọnụọgụ dị n'ederede na-akwado nkwupụta (popular), ma mee ajụjụ Bekee nwere ike ịlele nkwupụta ahụ.
x-e-e5-01.material:
'Klaasị Mina nwere akụkụ ịgụ akwụkwọ nwere ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ.

Our class has a reading corner. There are 20 books on the shelf. Twelve of them are about animals. Four are about space, and four are story books. The teacher did not buy any new books this year.

Mina says, "Animal books are the most popular in our class."'
x-e-e5-01.thinking.0: Itụnyere nkwupụta na nkọwa nke ederede
x-e-e5-01.thinking.2: Ime ajụjụ na-ejuputa ihe akaebe na-efu
x-e-e5-01.prereq.0: Okwu dị mfe dị ka most, popular, na about
x-e-e5-01.prereq.1: Okwu ọnụọgụ dị ka Twelve na four
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.prompt: Kpebie ma ederede ahụ na-akwado okwu Mina (akwụkwọ gbasara anụmanụ kacha ewu ewu).
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Chee ihe 'popular' pụtara n'okwu Mina, ma chọọ ahịrị okwu dị n'ederede na-agwa gị nke ahụ.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.hint.1: Chee ma 'ole dị n'ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ' na 'ugboro ole ụmụ akwụkwọ gụrụ ha' bụ otu ozi.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.a: Ihe akaebe zuru ezu. 12 n'ime akwụkwọ 20 bụ akwụkwọ gbasara anụmanụ, ya mere ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere ike ịgụ ha kacha.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.a: Lelee azụ ma ị were ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ na ọnụọgụ ugboro a gụrụ ha dị ka otu ihe.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.b: Ihe akaebe ezughị. Ọ nwere naanị ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ, ma ọ naghị ekwu akwụkwọ kedu ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agụ.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.b: Atụnyere m ma ozi nkwupụta chọrọ na ozi ederede na-enye bụ otu.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.o.c: Ihe akaebe zuru ezu. Onye nkụzi azụtaghị akwụkwọ ọhụrụ, ya mere ụmụ akwụkwọ ga-agụ naanị akwụkwọ ochie.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.r.c: Lelee ma 'did not buy new books' jikọtara na akwụkwọ kedu na-ewu ewu.
x-e-e5-01.s.s1.explain: Ederede naanị na-agwa ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ dị n'ebe a na-edebe akwụkwọ (akwụkwọ anụmanụ 12, wdg.). Ọ naghị ekwu akwụkwọ kedu ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agụ ma ọ bụ na-eji nke ukwuu, ya mere anyị enweghị ike ilele nkwupụta 'most popular'.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.prompt: Ka ị lelee ma okwu Mina ziri ezi, kedu ajụjụ ị ga-ajụ ụmụ akwụkwọ? Dee otu ahịrị okwu ajụjụ Bekee.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ otu omume na-egosi 'popular' (ịgụ, ịgbazinye, ịhọrọ).
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dee ajụjụ na-ajụ gbasara omume ahụ, ma tinye akara ajụjụ n'ọgwụgwụ.
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Azịza ajụjụ m ọ na-agwa 'akwụkwọ kedu ha na-agụ nke ukwuu'?
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ọ na-ajụ gbasara ihe ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eme, kama ịjụ ọnụọgụ akwụkwọ?
x-e-e5-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ajụjụ ọzọ dị mma na-elele site n'ọnụọgụ ugboro a gbazinyere.

x-e-e5-05.topic: Echiche bụ isi na nkọwa na-akwado
x-e-e5-05.title: Isi echiche na ahịrịokwu na-akwado n'ederede ubi ụlọ akwụkwọ
x-e-e5-05.goal: Họrọ isi echiche site n'ahịrịokwu, kewaa nkọwa na-akwado isi echiche na eziokwu dị mfe, ma mgbe ahụ mee ahịrịokwu na-akwado n'onwe gị.
x-e-e5-05.thinking.1: Hazie ozi na-akwado na ozi na-adịghị metụtara
x-e-e5-05.thinking.2: Mee ahịrịokwu nkọwa nke kwekọrọ n'isi echiche
x-e-e5-05.prereq.0: Ihe garden, plant, insect, na seed pụtara
x-e-e5-05.prereq.1: Ahụmahụ na paragraf bụ otu echiche buru ibu na obere echiche
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.prompt: Ahịrịokwu kedu kacha kwekọọ n'isi echiche nke ederede niile?
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tụnyere ma nhọrọ ọ bụla na-ekwu banyere otu akụkụ nke ederede naanị ma ọ bụ ọ na-ekpuchi ederede niile.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.hint.1: Jikọta otu nhọrọ na ahịrịokwu ọ bụla ọzọ nke ederede, ma chọta nke na-ejikọta na ọtụtụ ahịrịokwu.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.a: Nke a na-ele isi okwu dịka nkọwa n'otu ahịrịokwu nke ederede.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ eziokwu na-agwa ebe. Lelee ma ọ jikọtara n'ahịrịokwu ndị ọzọ.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.c: Nke a na-ele isi okwu dịka otu ihe naanị n'omume kwa ụbọchị.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.r.d: Nhọrọ a chere ma ọdịnaya nke ọtụtụ ahịrịokwu nwere ike ịkekọta n'otu.
x-e-e5-05.s.s1.explain: Ịkụ osisi n'ubi, ịgba mmiri, ilele na ide banyere ụmụ ahụhụ, na ịmụta ihe aṅụ na-eme niile jikọtara site n'echiche buru ibu 'ubi bụ ebe maka ịmụta ihe'. Nhọrọ ndị ọzọ bụ nke ọ bụla naanị otu eziokwu n'etiti ha.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu niile na-akwado isi echiche 'The garden helps students learn.'
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.hint.0: Gụọ nhọrọ ọ bụla ma jụọ onwe gị, 'Nke a ọ̀ bụ ihe akaebe na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-amụta?'
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.hint.1: Buru ụzọ gbaa nhọrọ ndị bụ eziokwu ma enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịmụta akara.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.a: Chee ma ọ bụ eziokwu nke jikọtara n'ịmụta.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.b: Nhọrọ a chere ma ihe ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eme bụ ihe akaebe nke ịmụta.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.c: Achọtara m ma jikọta ahịrịokwu nke na-ekwu ozugbo ihe e mụtara.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.r.d: Chee ma ozi banyere ebe na-egosi ịmụta.
x-e-e5-05.s.s2.explain: Ilele na ide banyere ụmụ ahụhụ na ihe ha mụtara banyere aṅụ bụ ihe akaebe nke ịmụta. Na ubi dị obere ma dị n'akụkụ ụlọ egwuregwu bụ eziokwu, ma ha bụ ozi enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ịmụta.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.prompt: Mee otu ahịrịokwu bekee ọhụrụ nke na-akwado isi echiche 'The garden helps students learn.' Ọ dị mma ma ọ naghị adị n'ederede.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.hint.0: Chee otu ihe ụmụ akwụkwọ nwere ike ịhụ ma ọ bụ otu ihe ha nwere ike ime n'ubi.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.hint.1: Dee ya n'otu ahịrịokwu site n'iji ngwaa dịka 'learn, observe, write'.
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ahịrịokwu m ọ̀ bụ ihe akaebe na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-amụta n'ubi?
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ị zere ikwu naanị nha ma ọ bụ ebe ubi dị?
x-e-e5-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ahịrịokwu ọzọ dị mma nke dere banyere ọrụ ilele.

x-e-e5-02.title: Chọta ma dozie ahịrị na-ezighị ezi n'nchịkọta Jin
x-e-e5-02.topic: Ịgụ obere ederede, mgbasa ozi, na ozi
x-e-e5-02.goal: Tụnyere obere ederede na nchịkọta ahịrị n'ahịrị, chọta ahịrị na-emegide ederede, ma dee ya ọzọ n'asụsụ Bekee.
x-e-e5-02.material:
"Obere ederede gbasara Ben.

Ben went to the lake on Saturday. He wanted to fish, but it rained in the morning, so he stayed at his uncle's house and played cards. In the afternoon the rain stopped. Ben and his uncle walked to the lake and caught two fish. They cooked the fish for dinner."
x-e-e5-02.thinking.0: Lelee ahịrị ọ bụla nke nchịkọta megide ahịrị okwu nke ederede
x-e-e5-02.thinking.1: Lelee usoro ihe omume na oge (ụtụtụ/ehihie)
x-e-e5-02.thinking.2: Idee ọzọ ahịrị okwu ka o dabara ederede
x-e-e5-02.prereq.0: Okwu dị mfe dị ka rain, lake, fish, na cook
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.prompt: Jin chịkọtara ederede a n'ahịrị anọ. Họrọ ahịrị na-adabaghị ederede.
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.hint.0: Gụọ ahịrị nke nchịkọta otu n'otu, chọta ahịrị okwu dị n'ederede ebe otu ọdịnaya ahụ na-apụta, ma tinye ha n'akụkụ ibe ha.
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kee okwu na-egosi oge (morning, afternoon, all day) ma tụnyere ha na ederede.
x-e-e5-02.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 2 na-ezighị ezi. N'ederede mmiri zoro naanị n'ụtụtụ ma kwụsị n'ehihie, ya mere Ben gbara azụ n'ehihie. Ahịrị 1, 3, na 4 dabara ederede.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.prompt: Dee ọzọ ahịrị na-ezighị ezi n'asụsụ Bekee ka o dabara ederede. Otu ahịrị okwu ma ọ bụ abụọ zuru ezu.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ chọta mgbe mmiri zoro na mgbe ọ kwụsịrị n'ederede.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.hint.1: Tinye oge abụọ ahụ (morning, afternoon) n'ahịrị okwu i dozitere.
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ọ gụnyere eziokwu na mmiri zoro naanị n'ụtụtụ?
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ọ dabara n'usoro na, n'ihi nke ahụ, o gbara azụ n'ehihie?
x-e-e5-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza ọzọ nke doziri ya site na 'only in the morning'.

x-e-e5-03.topic: Ịgụ obere ederede, mgbasa ozi, na ozi

BIG SALE! All bikes 30% off.

x-e-e5-03.thinking.1: Lelee ọnọdụ dị ka today only na 6 p.m.
x-e-e5-03.thinking.2: Gwa ihe na-adabaghị, na ihe akaebe
x-e-e5-03.prereq.0: Ihe sale, open, bike, na off pụtara
x-e-e5-03.s.s1.prompt: Mia kwuru atụmatụ ya n'ahịrị anọ. Họrọ otu ahịrị na-adabaghị mgbasa ozi. (E nwere ike ịbụ ahịrị abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa na-adabaghị. Ị nwere ike ịhọrọ naanị otu.)
x-e-e5-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ka ị na-agụ ahịrị ọ bụla nke mgbasa ozi, see akara n'okpuru okwu ndị kwuru ụbọchị ma ọ bụ oge.
x-e-e5-03.s.s1.hint.1: N'ime ahịrị Mia, tụnyere ahịrị na-ekwu ụbọchị ma ọ bụ oge na okwu ahụ n'mgbasa ozi.
x-e-e5-03.s.s1.explain: Ahịrị 3 na-ezighị ezi n'ihi 'Today only!' (echi anaghị ere ahịa), ma ahịrị 4 na-ezighị ezi n'ihi na ụlọ ahịa na-emechi na 6 p.m. ma ọ na-ekwu na ọ ga-aga na 7 p.m. Ahịrị 1 na 2 dabara mgbasa ozi.
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.prompt: Zaghachi Mia n'asụsụ Bekee. Gwa ya otu ihe n'atụmatụ ya nke agaghị arụ ọrụ, ya na ihe kpatara.
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ otu nkebiokwu sitere n'mgbasa ozi nke bụ nsogbu ma wetara ya dị ka ọ dị.
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.hint.1: Jiri so, nke pụtara 'so I can't ...', jikọta ya n'otu ahịrị okwu.
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ị kwuru nkebiokwu kedu nke mgbasa ozi bụ ihe kpatara ọ gaghị arụ ọrụ?
x-e-e5-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị gbakwunyere otu esi edozi ya (ịga taa, ịga tupu 6)? (nhọrọ)

x-e-e5-08.title: 'Meet at the cinema!' Gịnị ka m kwesịrị ịjụ?
x-e-e5-08.goal: Hazie ozi na-efu n'ozi enyi, ma dee ajụjụ ndị ị chọrọ n'ezie n'Bekee.
x-e-e5-08.material:
Dana na Eli bụ ndị klaasị. N'obodo Dana bi, e nwere sinima abụọ: Star Cinema na Moon Cinema.

Eli zigara Dana ederede.

Eli: "Let's see a movie on Saturday! I will buy the tickets. Meet me at the cinema!"
x-e-e5-08.thinking.0: Kewaa ihe ozi ahụ na-ekwuzi na ihe na-efu
x-e-e5-08.thinking.1: Họrọ ozi ị chọrọ n'ezie maka ebumnuche (izute)
x-e-e5-08.thinking.2: Dee ajụjụ abụọ dị mkpa n'Bekee
x-e-e5-08.prereq.0: Ihe cinema, ticket, na meet pụtara
x-e-e5-08.prereq.1: Udi ajụjụ dịka What time ...? / Which ...?
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ihe niile Dana ga-ajụ ka o doo anya na ọ ga-ezute Eli n'Satọde.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.hint.0: Buru ụzọ kaa akara ozi ederede na-enyelarị (ụbọchị, tiketi).
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.hint.1: Debe naanị ihe ị chọrọ maka 'izute'. Hapụ ajụjụ ndị dị mma inwe ma ị nwere ike izute n'enweghị ha.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.a: Nhọrọ a chọpụtara na ozi achọrọ maka izute bụ oge.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.b: Nhọrọ a jikọtara eziokwu na e nwere sinima abụọ na ederede.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.c: Lelee ọzọ ma ederede na-ekwu onye na-azụ tiketi.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụ ajụjụ dị mma inwe, ma chee ma ọ dị mkpa n'ezie maka izute.
x-e-e5-08.s.s1.explain: Ederede ahụ nwere ụbọchị (Saturday) na na Eli na-azụ tiketi, mana ọ nweghị oge ha ga-ezute na sinima kedu. E nwere sinima abụọ n'obodo ahụ, ya mere ị ga-ajụ abụọ. Ihe nkiri ị kacha masị abụghị ihe dị mkpa n'ezie maka ezumike.
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.prompt: Dee n'asụsụ Bekee nzaghachi Dana na-ezigara Eli. Tinye ajụjụ abụọ ị chọrọ n'ezie.
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.hint.0: Dee ihe abụọ ị họọrọ na s1 nke ọ bụla dị ka ajụjụ otu ahịrịokwu.
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ajụjụ banyere oge nwere ike ịmalite na What time, ma ajụjụ banyere ebe nwere ike ịmalite na Which ma ọ bụ Where.
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ajụjụ oge na sinima abụọ ọ̀ dị n'ime ya?
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Eli ọ̀ pụrụ izaa ozugbo mgbe ọ gụchara naanị nzaghachi a?
x-e-e5-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza ọzọ dị mma nke jụrụ banyere ebe na oge mmalite.

x-e-e5-06.title: Ọkwa Swim Day abụọ: gịnị dị iche?
x-e-e5-06.goal: Tụnyere ọkwa abụọ ihe ọ bụla, kewaa 'ọdịiche n'ezie' na ihe 'na-adị ka ha dị iche ma abụghị mgbagha', ma dee ajụjụ nlele n'Bekee.
x-e-e5-06.material:
Ọkwa Swim Day abụọ si n'ụlọ akwụkwọ Mina bịa.

Notice A (school office)
Swim Day. Date: Friday, June 7.
Meet: school gate, 8:30 a.m.
Bring: swimsuit, towel, swimming cap.

Notice B (homeroom teacher)
Swim Day is on Friday, June 7. The bus leaves at 9:00 a.m. Please bring a swimsuit and a towel. If it rains, we will go on June 14.
x-e-e5-06.thinking.0: Tụnyere ederede abụọ ihe ọ bụla
x-e-e5-06.thinking.1: Kewaa otu ọdịnaya, ọdịnaya dị iche, na ọdịnaya dị naanị n'otu n'ime ha
x-e-e5-06.prereq.0: Ihe swimsuit, towel, cap, na gate pụtara
x-e-e5-06.prereq.1: Ịgụ ụbọchị (June 7 = nke asaa nke June)
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe ị tụnyere ọkwa abụọ ahụ, họrọ 'ọdịiche n'ezie' niile (ozi dị naanị n'otu, ma ọ bụ ozi na-adabaghị).
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.hint.0: Dọta tebụl nwere ihe anọ, ụbọchị, oge, ihe ị ga-eweta, na ihe na-eme ma mmiri ozuzo ezo, ma mejupụta A na B.
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.hint.1: Maka ihe ọ bụla, lelee ma "ihe" A na B na-ekwu banyere ya bụ otu, ma ọ bụ ha na-ekwu banyere ihe dị iche.
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.o.a: Ụbọchị: A na-ekwu June 7 ma B na-ekwu June 14.
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.r.a: Gụọ ọzọ n'ikpe kedu ka a na-eji ụbọchị June 14 n'B.
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.o.b: Swimming cap: e dere ya naanị n'A.
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.r.b: Ahụrụ m ma tụnyere ahịrị ihe ị ga-eweta nke ederede abụọ ahụ ihe ọ bụla.
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.o.c: Oge: A na-ekwu 8:30 ma B na-ekwu 9:00, ya mere ha na-emegiderịta onwe ha.
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.r.c: Lelee ma 8:30 na 9:00 na-ekwu banyere otu ihe (izute/ịhapụ).
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.o.d: If it rains: ọ dị naanị n'B.
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.r.d: Achọtara m ozi dị naanị n'otu n'ime ha.
x-e-e5-06.s.s1.explain: E dere swimming cap naanị n'A, atụmatụ maka mmiri ozuzo dịkwa naanị n'B. June 14 n'B bụ naanị ụbọchị maka mgbe mmiri na-ezo ma ọ dịghị iche n'A, 8:30 bụkwa oge izute n'ọnụ ụzọ ụlọ akwụkwọ ebe 9:00 bụ oge bọs na-apụ, ya mere ha anaghị emegide ibe ha.
x-e-e5-06.s.s2.prompt: Dee obere ederede ajụjụ nye onye nkụzi n'Bekee. Lelee otu ihe ọkwa abụọ ahụ na-ekwu n'ụzọ dị iche ma ọ bụ nke dị naanị n'otu n'ime ha.
x-e-e5-06.s.s2.hint.0: Họrọ otu n'ọdịiche 'n'ezie' ị họrọ n's1.
x-e-e5-06.s.s2.hint.1: Dee otu ajụjụ dịka ahịrịokwu ajụjụ bekee ma tinye akara ajụjụ n'ọgwụgwụ.
x-e-e5-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ajụjụ m ọ̀ na-eji akụkụ ebe ọkwa abụọ ahụ na-ekwu ihe dị iche?
x-e-e5-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Onye nkụzi ọ̀ nwere ike ịza site n''ee/mba' ma ọ bụ n'otu ahịrịokwu?
x-e-e5-06.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ajụjụ ọzọ dị mma nke na-elele atụmatụ maka mgbe mmiri na-ezo.
x-e-e5-06.s.s2.modelNote.2: Ajụjụ na-elele ma ebe izute nke dị naanị n'A ma bọs nke dị naanị n'B.

x-e-e5-07.title: Ọkwa ọgbakọ gbanwere: gwa Sam
x-e-e5-07.goal: Kpee ikpe site n'ihe akaebe nke n'ọkwa abụọ nwere ụbọchị dị iche ka a ga-eso, ma gwa enyi nke hụrụ naanị poster ochie ihe gbanwere, n'Bekee.
x-e-e5-07.material:
Sam bụ onye otu ọhụrụ nke klọb akwụkwọ. Sam hụrụ naanị poster ochie n'mgbidi ụzọ ọnụ. Ị bụ onye otu klọb, ya mere ị hụkwara ihe ndetu ọhụrụ.

Poster (Sep. 1)
Book Club. Tuesday, 4:00 p.m. Room 5. New members welcome!

Note (Sep. 20)
CHANGE! From next week, Book Club is on Wednesday at 4:00 p.m. in the library.
x-e-e5-07.thinking.0: Ikpe ọkwa kedu bụ kacha ọhụrụ site n'ụbọchị na akara mgbanwe
x-e-e5-07.thinking.1: Kewaa ozi ochie na ozi ọhụrụ
x-e-e5-07.thinking.2: Dee n'ụzọ dị mfe, naanị ozi onye na-anata chọrọ
x-e-e5-07.prereq.0: Ihe change, library, Room, na Wednesday/Tuesday pụtara
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.prompt: Ọkwa kedu ka Sam kwesịrị isoro izu na-abịa?

x-e-e5-07.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere ihe ọkwa abụọ ahụ nke ọ bụla na-ekwu banyere usoro mbụ.
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.o.a: Soro ọkwa abụọ ahụ. Gaa n'ọgbakọ ma n'Tuzde ma n'Wenezde.
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.r.a: Chee ma ị nwere ike ijikọta ọkwa abụọ ahụ n'otu usoro.
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.o.b: Soro ihe ndetu September 20. Ọ pụtara ka e mechara ma na-ekwu na ọ bụ mgbanwe.
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.r.b: Ị họrọ ozi kacha ọhụrụ dabere n'ụbọchị na akara mgbanwe.
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.o.c: Soro poster September 1. A na-ebinye ya n'mgbidi ma ọ bụ usoro e setịpụrụ na mbụ, ya mere ọ kacha ntụkwasị obi.
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.r.c: Chee azụ ihe ị jiri dịka ntọala: ebe e debere ya, ma ọ bụ mgbe e mere ya.
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.o.d: Ejila nke ọ bụla tụkwasị obi, ma ghara ịga ruo mgbe onye nkụzi gwara gị.
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.r.d: Nke a bụ nhọrọ nke na-akwụsị ịlele ọbụlagodi na e nwere ihe akaebe.
x-e-e5-07.s.s1.explain: Ihe ndetu ahụ bụ nke e mechara, Sep. 20, ma na-ekwu 'CHANGE!'. Ya mere klọb ahụ nọ ugbu a n'Wenezde n'elekere 4, n'ọbá akwụkwọ. Na ọ nọgidere n'mgbidi ogologo oge abụghị ihe akaebe na ozi ahụ bụ nke ọhụrụ.
x-e-e5-07.s.s2.prompt: Dee Sam obere ozi n'Bekee. Gwa ya ụbọchị na ebe ọhụrụ, ma kwukwa na ọ dị iche n'poster. Jiri okwu dị mfe.
x-e-e5-07.s.s2.hint.0: Dee ozi ochie Sam maralarị na ozi ọhụrụ, otu ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla.
x-e-e5-07.s.s2.hint.1: Were okwu ụbọchị na ebe site n'ihe ndetu ozugbo.
x-e-e5-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Sam ọ̀ nwere ike ịmata ebe na mgbe ọ ga-aga site n'ịgụ ozi a naanị?
x-e-e5-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ị dere ya ka e ghara ịgwakọta ya na ozi ochie (Tuzde, Room 5)?
x-e-e5-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Azịza ọzọ e dere n'ụzọ mkpụmkpụ na dị mfe.

x-e-e5-09.title: Ịrịọ onye nkụzi ka o gbanwee oche gị
x-e-e5-09.goal: Họrọ okwu arịrịọ na ihe kpatara doro anya kwesịrị onye ọzọ (onye nkụzi) na ọnọdụ ahụ, ma dee ọzọ nkebiokwu siri ike ka ọ bụrụ arịrịọ nwere nsọpụrụ.
x-e-e5-09.material: Hana na-anọdụ n'oche n'azụ n'ime klas ma ọ naghị ahụ ihe e dere n'bọọdụ nke ọma. Ahịrịokwu Hana buru ụzọ dee bụ nke a: "Move my seat." Ọ chọrọ ịrịọ onye nkụzi ya (Mr. Kim) ka o gbanwee oche ya.
x-e-e5-09.thinking.0: Ịlele ma arịrịọ na ihe kpatara abụọ dị
x-e-e5-09.thinking.1: Idozi ụda ka ọ dabara onye na-anata
x-e-e5-09.thinking.2: Ide ihe kpatara doro anya nke onye ọzọ pụrụ ikpe
x-e-e5-09.prereq.0: Ihe Could I ...? / May I ...? pụtara
x-e-e5-09.prereq.2: Ihe board, seat, na sit pụtara
x-e-e5-09.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nke kacha kwesị ekwesị dị ka arịrịọ nye onye nkụzi?
x-e-e5-09.s.s1.hint.0: Maka nhọrọ ọ bụla, kaa akara ma ọ nwere 'okwu arịrịọ' na 'ihe kpatara' abụọ.
x-e-e5-09.s.s1.hint.1: Chee echiche eziokwu na onye na-ege ntị bụ onye nkụzi, tụnyekwa ụda.
x-e-e5-09.s.s1.r.a: Ọ nwere ihe kpatara, mana lelee ọzọ ma ụda ahụ kwesịrị ikwu okwu nye onye nkụzi.
x-e-e5-09.s.s1.r.b: Nke a bụ nhọrọ nke lelere na okwu arịrịọ na ihe kpatara abụọ dị.
x-e-e5-09.s.s1.r.c: Ọ nwere nsọpụrụ, mana lelee ma e nwere ihe kpatara onye nkụzi pụrụ ikpe.
x-e-e5-09.s.s1.explain: b na-ajụ n'ụzọ nsọpụrụ site na 'Could I ...?, please' ma nwekwa ihe kpatara na ọ naghị ahụ bọọdụ. a nwere ihe kpatara mana ụda ya bụ iwu, c nwere nsọpụrụ mana enweghị ihe kpatara, ya mere o siri ike ka onye nkụzi kpee ikpe.
x-e-e5-09.s.s2.prompt: Dee ọzọ "Move my seat." nke Hana n'asụsụ Bekee dị ka arịrịọ nwere nsọpụrụ nye onye nkụzi. Tinye arịrịọ na ihe kpatara abụọ.
x-e-e5-09.s.s2.hint.0: Buru ụzọ dee arịrịọ ahụ site na 'Could I / May I / Can I ...?'.
x-e-e5-09.s.s2.hint.1: Gbakwunye ihe kpatara (ọ naghị ahụ bọọdụ nke ọma) site na because ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu ọzọ.
x-e-e5-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Onye nkụzi ọ̀ pụrụ ịmata 'ihe kpatara' mgbe o gụchara ya?
x-e-e5-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ọ̀ bụ ụda arịrịọ, ọ bụghị iwu?

x-e-e5-10.title: Ịrịọ ikike: ime ihe kpatara na nhọrọ ọzọ

x-e-e5-10.material: E nwere ihe n'ụlọ ma ọ bụ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ chọrọ ikike. Onye toro eto na-ekpebi ma ọ ga-enye arịrịọ ahụ mgbe ọ nụchara ihe kpatara.
x-e-e5-10.thinking.0: Tụnyere ka ihe kpatara si baa uru (ma ha doro anya)

x-e-e5-10.prereq.1: Ihe need to na must pụtara
x-e-e5-10.s.s1.prompt: Ndị a bụ ihe atọ ị pụrụ ịgwa Mama iji jụọ ma ị pụrụ ịga n'ụlọ enyi. Kedu nke kacha enyere Mama aka ikpebi?

x-e-e5-10.s.s1.hint.1: Tụnyere ma ihe kpatara n'nhọrọ ọ bụla na-enye ozi nke Mama pụrụ iji kpebie.

x-e-e5-10.s.s1.r.b: Chee echiche ma ikwu na ndị ọzọ na-eme ya na-enyere Mama aka ikpebi.
x-e-e5-10.s.s1.r.c: Nke a bụ nhọrọ nke lelere ma e nwere ihe kpatara Mama pụrụ ikpe.
x-e-e5-10.s.s1.explain: Ihe kpatara n'c, "I have to finish my science homework," bụ ozi doro anya nke na-ekwe ka Mama kpee ikpe ka ọ dị mkpa. a na-ekwu naanị mmetụta, ya mere o nwere obere ozi iji kpebie, ma b bụ banyere ọnọdụ ndị ọzọ.

x-e-e5-10.s.s2.hint.1: Dee ihe kpatara dị ka ọnọdụ doro anya nke onye na-ege ntị pụrụ iji kpebie.
